Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a special environmental crimes prosecutor in the office of the attorney general.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an environmental crimes prosecutor;adding a new section to chapter 43.10 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 43.21A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is established in the office of the attorney general aspecial environmental crimes prosecutor, whose sole function is toprosecute criminal violations of the environmental laws of the statethat have caused serious harm to public health, safety, or theenvironment. The attorney general shall appoint the specialenvironmental crimes prosecutor with the advice and confirmation of thesenate, who shall serve during the term of office of the attorneygeneral. The attorney general, upon request of the specialenvironmental crimes prosecutor, may employ such professional,technical, research, and clerical staff as may be necessary withinavailable appropriations. The prosecutor may call upon the assistanceand services of the department of ecology, other state agencies, anycounty prosecuting attorney, any law enforcement office in the state, p. 1 SB 5883and any other state or local government official or employee for thepurpose of carrying out the function of the prosecutor establishedunder this section. (2) The special environmental crimes prosecutor may from time totime provide recommendations to the attorney general and to thelegislature for modifications to the state's environmental criminalstatutes and other statutes to strengthen deterrence againstenvironmental violations, to improve the administration and prosecutionof environmental crimes proceedings, and to strengthen the state'sinterests in cases where there is concurrent federal and stateenvironmental crimes jurisdiction.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of ecology shall provide assistance as requested bythe special environmental crimes prosecutor in carrying out thecriminal investigation and prosecutorial functions assigned undersection 1 of this act.
